limitations: Nominatim is a community-map geocoder, and its display-name locality labels are not official administrative boundaries.
OpenStreetMap is community maintained and not a hydrographic survey; name/tag agreement does not validate this river identity, route extent, water condition, habitat, or fishing access.

The official profile locates named river portions only within a protected landscape spanning Ternate, Maragondon, and Nasugbu; no source crosswalk connects the returned ways to the named management-zone reaches.
A zero Nominatim result only means no matching search result was returned for these exact queries. It is not evidence that the named waterbody is absent.
OSM data use ODbL 1.0. Raw geometry stays local; any later distribution needs qualified license and attribution review.
nextAction: Seek an independent official or locally documented route/locality crosswalk for the Palicpican candidates and for the three no-result leads. Keep all four unassigned, keep OSM geometry out of the app, and do not infer species presence, access, or rules from this screen.
